calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.subtitle: Tune servos and the feeder
calibration.entrySubtitle: Servo positions, timings and the feeder
calibration.notConnectedDescription: Calibration moves the servos live, so the sorter has to be connected.
calibration.noPositionSelected: Select a position above to edit it
calibration.rawPulseTooltip: Raw servo pulse position (120-490), the exact value sent to the device.
calibration.testServoGate: Test: briefly opens the gate, then returns it to closed, so you can watch it move.
calibration.testServoPusher: Test: briefly fires the pusher left, then right, then returns it to neutral, so you can watch it move both ways.
calibration.pusherOffsetWarning: More than {{percent}}% away from neutral. The arm shouldn't touch the inner wall, and the further out you push it, the higher the risk of skipping gears or the horn shifting on the shaft.

paddleOpenDelay.label: Paddle Open Delay (ms)
paddleOpenDelay.description: How long the paddle gets to lower before the pusher fires. Longer if the pusher hits the card before the paddle is fully down; shorter to sort faster.

pusherHoldDuration.label: Pusher Hold Time (ms)
pusherHoldDuration.description: How long the pusher stays extended before returning to neutral. Longer if cards aren't pushed fully out before it retracts; keep it short, since holding against the end stop strains the servo horn.

paddleCloseDelay.label: Paddle Close Delay (ms)
paddleCloseDelay.description: How long after the pusher fires before this module's paddle closes again, independent of the pusher's own return timing. Longer if cards aren't fully clear before the gate shuts.

calibration.pushTestTooltip: Runs this module's push exactly as a route would, using the hold time and paddle close delay above (even before you save them). No card is fed; drop one onto the module first to see it pushed out.

feeder.heading: Feeder
feeder.speedTooltip: How fast and which way the feeder motor spins. 0% is stopped; drag either way to speed up in that direction.
feeder.settleDurationDescription: Extra time to keep feeding once the module 1 sensor sees the last card in the hopper, so it travels all the way into the mechanism before the motor stops.
feeder.reverseDurationDescription: Once a card reaches module 1, spin the roller backward this long so the next card in the hopper is pulled back instead of creeping forward into a double feed. 0 turns it off.

calibration.calibrateBeforeTest: Calibrate all modules before running the test
calibration.testBeforeControls: Run a successful test to unlock the device controls.
calibration.saveFailed: Failed to save the scan region or capture settle delay
calibration.discardDescription: Your calibration changes haven't been saved. Discarding puts the saved values back on the sorter.

moduleCount.reduceDescription: Dropping to {{count}} modules will remove the sorting rules and calibration data for modules and bins beyond that count, across every bin preset.

scanRegion.heading: Scan region
scanRegion.instructions: Drag the box to move it and use the sliders to resize it. Line it up with a card sitting at module 1.
scanRegion.liveDetectionHint: The box is the fallback crop used when live detection can't find the card. The blue outline is a live preview of what detection sees.
scanRegion.captureSettleDescription: How long to wait after the feeder confirms a card has arrived before capturing a frame, so the card is fully still and in focus.
scanRegion.matchesNeededDescription: How many consecutive frames must agree on the same card before a scan is accepted. 1 is fastest; higher values are more reliable but slower.
scanRegion.checkBothOrientationsDescription: Also match the card rotated 180°, so cards fed upside down are still identified. Turn off if all your cards are fed the same way up to make each scan faster.

connection.title: Connection
connection.autoConnectDescription: Connects to this sorter on its own when the app opens, and keeps trying to reconnect if it drops or is power-cycled while the app is open. Connect it by hand once first so the phone remembers it.
connection.testOnConnectDescription: When on, the sorter cycles every servo and checks its sensors each time it connects. When off, it only loads its saved calibration and is ready right away. You can still run the test from Sorter setup.
connection.pipelinedFeedLabel: Scan the next card while sorting
connection.pipelinedFeedDescription: Feeds and scans the next card as soon as the previous one has left module 1, instead of waiting for it to reach its bin. Needs firmware 2.1.0 or newer and auto-feed turned on. Turn this off if cards jam or scans start picking up the moving card.
connection.firmwareNote: Firmware updates need the desktop app, since they're flashed over USB.

storage.businessOnly: Storage locations are part of the Business plan.
storage.locked: Record which box every card goes into, and where in it, when you empty a bin.
storage.lockedWithLocations: You can still browse, search and edit your locations, but recording new cards into them needs Business.

ocrBetaDialog.title: OCR text matching (beta)
ocrBetaDialog.description: When a scan isn't a confident match, this reads the card's name and set line to find the card or pick the right printing. Confident matches skip it, so scanning speed is unchanged. It's still in beta and can misread text. Turn it back off if it seems to be making matches worse.

correctionAutoClose.promptToggleLabel: Ask me to move corrected cards
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleDescription: Turn this off if you leave corrected cards where they were sorted. The card keeps its current bin and no prompt is shown.
correctionAutoClose.description: After you correct or identify a card, a prompt shows which bin it's in and which bin it belongs in. Auto-close accepts that you moved the card once the time runs out, so you don't have to click.
correctionAutoClose.toggleLabel: Auto-close and mark the card as moved
